note: Both sets struggle with correctly binding dimensions to the specific beam details, resulting in numerous misattributions. Set A is slightly better as it correctly extracts the beam sections for several details (e.g., W10X15 for Floor Beam @ Grid 5) and captures the general note about the edge radius. Set B incorrectly identifies the section for Floor Beam near Grid 5 as W8X13 (it is W10X15) and misinterprets several offsets as heights or widths.
